summary: Our project is an immersive space exploration and survival game designed to give players the ultimate experience of living and discovering the unknown. The gameplay is structured into two main phases: Pre-Mission (where players undergo rigorous physical, technical, and mental training, manage equipment, and strategize their approach) and In-Mission (where players execute the journey to destinations like the dwarf planet Ceres, utilizing advanced propulsion systems, managing life support, and exploring mysterious terrain). By blending realistic scientific challenges with interactive gameplay, we empower players to truly feel like space pioneers discovering secrets of the cosmos.
